Box Office: 'Hanuman Ansh' Dominates, New Films Struggle

The film 'Hanuman Ansh' continues to perform strongly at the box office, maintaining its dominance even after a month in theaters. New releases, including 'Vibe' and 'Dayra', have struggled to gain traction against it. 'Mirzapur' has been noted as the third hit of the year. Producers of 'Hanuman Ansh' have expressed confidence that the film will surpass ₹400 crore in earnings, unaffected by the upcoming release of 'Drishyam 3' on October 2.
